verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's own Post-Incident Reviews are documented to "coordinate preventative follow-up actions," and the Scribe Agent records action items from incident calls, so the product captures and coordinates follow-ups. Nothing shows those actions are tracked to completion or synced to an issue tracker; the bare "Integrate with ITSM Tools" heading is not about follow-up actions, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented follow-up action status and completion tracking, documented sync of action items to an issue tracker such as Jira, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, follow-up actions from incidents are tracked to completion and sync to our issue tracker

citations.quote: Schedule a Scribe Agent to join incident calls and record key decisions, action items, and events once a conference bridge is available.
Teams can start PIRs directly from the incident detail page or Slack after resolving an incident
